newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV trade on Caracas bolsa may begin Friday.
newsitem.headline: CANTV trade on Caracas bolsa may begin Friday.

text.p: Opening trade on the Caracas bolsa of shares in Venezuelan telephone company CANTV may be moved forward to this Friday, the same date as trade is slated to open on the New York Stock Exchange, high-placed sources told Reuters.

"Just a few minutes ago, the National Securities Commission (CNV) told us that CANTV shares may be traded in Caracas on Friday ... but with some restrictions," said the source, who asked to remain anonymous.
Previously, trade on the Caracas bolsa for the 50 million shares the government is offering to domestic investors was scheduled to begin December 2.
The source could not provide any further details as to what restrictions might apply to trade on the Caracas bourse.
The domestic placement is part of a larger offering of some 289 million shares that is expected to bring in over $1 billion in revenues.
